title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Service Requests and Service Call Fees
content:
## Accepting a rider service request

Rider service requests under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons are accepted only while the rider status is active; the status is read from Bridgewell's records of the rider. The base contract must also be in force for service (active, or for a real estate base, active) on the request date.

A rider service request is either a new failure of a rider-covered component, a recall, or a request for the included septic pumping.

## Fees in force

- **Pumping and recalls.** A septic pumping request, and a recall placed no later than the rider's repair guarantee period in calendar days after the earlier rider repair was completed, carry no fee.
- **Refunds.** The fee is refunded only when the request is cancelled before a contractor is assigned, or when it was charged in error.
- **Included pumping.** Septic pumping may be requested only while the pumpings used in the current rider term are below the rider's included pumpings per term.

## Retired clauses, in part

1. The clause that a new-failure rider request carries the base contract's service call fee (the contract's elected service call fee on a homeowner service contract, and the base tier's service call fee on a rental property or real estate contract) is **no longer in force** for a rider on a homeowner service contract, whose new-failure request fee is set under the current basis for the rider visit fee. A rider on a rental property or real estate contract still carries the base tier's service call fee.
2. The clause that, when the rider's published terms carry no separate fee in a shared visit and the rider component is serviced in the same visit and trade as an open base contract request, no rider fee is charged, is **no longer in force** for a rider on a homeowner service contract, for which the current basis of the rider visit fee decides when a request counts as serviced in the same visit and trade. For a rider on a rental property or real estate contract it remains in force: no rider fee is charged when the component is serviced in the same visit and trade as an open request on that base contract.

## Fee outcomes for a rider on a rental property or real estate contract

| Request | Fee |
|---|---|
| New failure, serviced in the same visit and trade as an open request on the base contract | None |
| New failure, on its own | The base tier's service call fee |
| Septic pumping | None |
| Recall no later than the repair guarantee period after the earlier rider repair was completed | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, a 30-day repair guarantee as published for every rider)

- A rider repair is completed on 1 April and a recall is placed on 1 May, 30 calendar days later: no fee.
- A request placed while the rider is still in its waiting period is not accepted, because the rider status is not active.
- A Bridgewell Septic System Rider that has used its one included pumping in the current term cannot take a further pumping request in that term.

superseded_clauses: A new_failure rider request carries the base contract's service call fee: the contract's service_call_fee on a homeowner service contract, and the base tier's service_call_fee on a rental property or real estate contract.
When concurrent_visit_single_fee is true and the rider component is serviced in the same visit and trade as an open base contract request, no rider fee is charged.
